entries.authorizationModeDerivation: the entry needs an effective exact owner act (RFC3-16(a)) and the effective egress consent for the (project:syzygy, provider:anthropic) pair; owner-trusted-bootstrap while those acts are state (1); every other combination dispatches nothing
entries.provenanceDisclosure: The route is admitted on owner-trusted records; independent audit is not configured.

inputClasses.identityScheme: not-recorded: the name of the one environment variable that supplies it is recorded; its presence is a precondition, its value and identity are never written to a record or log

entries.determinism: every output is a recording of what the provider returned at a capture instant; a re-dispatch may legitimately differ. The generated prose is editorial inference, never an Observed claim and never repeatable by contract

typedAuthority.authorityTypeLabel: [Inferred] a provider is an external authority of project:syzygy under RFC4-1; the typed-authority list in the RFC names version control, hosting, the scheduler and the OpenSpec CLI as examples, so this type name is the drafter's
questions: What did the provider return for this exact request?
typedAuthority.readAuthority: none: the route reads no source. It transmits the request the generator built (the stage system prompt and the stage input envelope, each after the single egress check, RFC5-15) together with the profile-set fields and the headers listed in full in requestBytes, and receives the reply. [Observed, capture endpoint, no provider contacted] the body is exactly: model, max_tokens, system (a string), messages (one user message whose content is the stage input string), output_config.effort, stream, and the profile's thinking field when it is not off; there is no tools, metadata, context or cache_control field, no subprocess, no probe request and no ?beta query
typedAuthority.runDirectoryWrites: provider requests, replies and run records are written inside the run directory under project:syzygy's state directory, outside git, from the start of the run (the egress record's retention line). The route has no subprocess and no runtime state or session transcript of its own. [Unknown] whether the SDK library writes any file outside that directory; the isolation test (PR #264) shows only the capture endpoint named on one successful path and checks no file writes
networkAccess: the Anthropic API host, POST /v1/messages only, from the loopback runtime egress gate, signed with the API key in the x-api-key header; no probe, no other path and no other destination
typedAuthority.generatorBuiltContent: exactly two request parts are generator content: the stage system prompt (the system field, a string) and the stage input envelope (the content of the one user message, a string). Everything else in the request is listed in requestBytes as SDK-fixed or pinned by this entry and carries no source span
typedAuthority.writeSurfaceArgument: writeSurface is empty because nothing is written to the observed repository, its forks, its tracker or any Anthropic-hosted object the owner could later edit. The dispatch itself is an effect (the pipeline rechecks effect permission immediately before it, and the runtime egress gate asks the consent switch again for every request, retries included); the egress consent is the explicit authority for that effect and for the provider's retention under the account's terms, which this entry does not widen
typedAuthority.toolInvocationNote: the empty list holds: the body carries no tools field, and the adapter refuses any reply content block that is not text, thinking or redacted thinking, so a tool call is never output

credential.kind: API key only; no subscription sign-in, no OAuth, no credential file
credential.source: one environment variable, SYZYGY_POLARIS_PROVIDER_API_KEY [Inferred: the name is this entry's proposal; the adapter takes the key as its apiKey configuration value and no code at the cited commit reads any environment variable for it, so the caller that builds the configuration reads exactly this variable and no other]. [Observed in the adapter source] the adapter throws ambient-environment if any variable whose name starts with ANTHROPIC_ is set in the process, so the variable cannot carry that prefix and the conventional ANTHROPIC_API_KEY must be unset
credential.disclosure: the key leaves the machine in the x-api-key header of the one forwarded request, to the upstream host only; the gate refuses any request whose x-api-key differs from the configured key
credential.neverLogged: the key is never written to a record, log, error or receipt. [Observed in the adapter source at drafting] the failure object carries a closed code, an attempt count and a status; the attempt record carries ids, outcome, status, usage and backoff; the gate decision records are content-free; none has a credential field. A later version's offering re-checks this against the implementation
credential.refresh: none: a static key is neither refreshed nor rewritten

runtimeEgressGate.name: the loopback runtime egress gate (startEgressGate)
runtimeEgressGate.source: packages/polaris-generation-provider/src/egress-gate.ts and messages-api-provider.ts at commit e76b692926d89342e7943ce0a2d7ef669a859b47 of PR #264, blobs as pinned in requestBytes.provenance. Unmerged; provenance only, and the rules below are the entry's own statement of what the implementation will enforce
rules: the adapter's client is pointed at an in-process loopback server and never at a provider

a request is forwarded only when all hold: (1) the current try armed an acceptance predicate and the exact request satisfies it (body fields by value, header names and values against the literals and shapes in requestBytes, x-api-key equal to the configured key); (2) the injected consent switch permitted() returns exactly true now, asked again for every request, retries included; (3) an explicit upstream is configured
otherwise the gate answers 403 and no byte leaves; one try is armed at a time
the gate removes the incoming host and connection headers and forwards the rest unchanged; it forwards to the one configured upstream only
a body-less HEAD /api/hello is answered by the gate and never forwarded; this route sends none
the gate may drop x-stainless-os, x-stainless-arch and x-stainless-runtime-version from the forwarded request (stripFingerprint, default off); it never adds or alters a byte
runtimeEgressGate.limits: [Observed in the source] the gate sees only HTTP to its own port; anything the process does outside that port is bounded by the environment, the run directory and the isolation test, not by the gate

routeConditions.source: record PUBLIC-EGRESS-anthropic of the public-repo admission package (PR #215), record version 0.1.0-candidate.7. A version string does not identify bytes (the record kept that version across edits), so this entry pins the bytes it was compared against: path .syzygy/governance/contracts/candidates/public-repo-admission/instances/egress-anthropic/EGRESS-CONSENT-ANTHROPIC.md, git blob 57f11a71e944e94f640f1748358e76faba49ae90, identical at commit 7704b4a575acf29de93e3872ff549a856e6395ec and at the branch head b17207ce7d2d5d314b683e111e4440886916cffe at drafting; the offering step re-pins the record by the digest of its own manifest row. The egress record is the authority; this block only declares what the implementation will enforce and cannot widen it
routeConditions.tools: the body carries no tools field and no tool of the provider's side is offered or invoked; a reply content block that is not text, thinking or redacted thinking is refused as no output
routeConditions.ambientContext: none: the request carries no instruction or memory files, settings, MCP servers, hooks, environment summary, safeguards block, metadata or context field, and no system prefix of the SDK's own. The only model-visible bytes the generator did not build are the profile-set fields listed in requestBytes (model, max_tokens, output_config.effort and the thinking field when on), which steer the model without being context. [Observed in the adapter source] the adapter refuses to start when any ANTHROPIC_-prefixed environment variable is set, so the SDK's base URL, auth token and custom-header variables cannot redirect, re-authenticate or add headers
routeConditions.telemetry: the route has no subprocess, runtime or update check; the SDK is a library called in-process and sends nothing outside the gated request. [Observed, capture endpoint] the one successful path names no other socket address; error paths beyond 429 and 529 were not captured
routeConditions.stateLocation: the route keeps no state or transcript of its own; run records are written inside the run directory. A run whose adapter cannot write there does not start
routeConditions.acceptanceCheck: the adapter is accepted only when a request captured at a local endpoint, before any real call, shows (1) the generator-built parts (system string, user message string) byte for byte equal to what the generator built and (2) every other byte equal to requestBytes: bodyFields, sdkFixed, routeFixedByThisEntry, headers (literals, shapes, value rules and closedSet) and probe, for the pinned SDK version. Any byte, header or field in neither fails. The check admits no profile-set byte beyond the values this entry pins. The same predicate is enforced per request by the runtime egress gate
routeConditions.fallback: none: a failure never routes to another provider, to the Agent SDK route or to a tool

egressRecordFit.status: [Inferred] a drafter's comparison of this entry with the confirmed egress record bytes pinned in source; the owner reads the record's own wording
fitsWithoutNewVersion: permitted content classes and the generated field table: route-independent; the route sends system as the system prompt and input as the user message, exactly the table's last block of rows
no tools on the provider's or the route's side: satisfied (no tools field)
adds no context of its own: satisfied more strictly than the Agent SDK route (no system prefix, no metadata, no environment message)
telemetry, error reporting and update checks disabled: vacuous, no runtime process exists
retention in the run directory: satisfied; there is no runtime state to keep
needsReading: the record's 'Provider and route' line and title name the Claude Agent SDK (Claude Code runtime). If the owner reads that as descriptive, this route fits; if as restrictive, this route needs an egress record version that names the Messages API route, a text-only change that adds no class and no destination

the record says a field outside the table is refused and the route adds 'only the bytes that its registered provider execution route entry lists as fixed by the runtime'. model, max_tokens, output_config.effort and thinking are not table fields and are not fixed by a runtime; this entry pins them (the same method the Agent SDK entry uses), and stream and the headers are fixed by the SDK library. Whether pinned profile fields satisfy 'fixed by the runtime' is the owner's reading and is the same open point as the Agent SDK entry's

the record says the adapter is accepted only when a captured request shows the system prompt and messages the generator built 'and nothing else'. The captured body also carries the profile-set fields. If read literally, a text-only egress version is needed for either route
egressRecordFit.conclusion: no enforceable condition of the record is violated by this route; two wordings (the route name, 'nothing else') need the owner's reading, and the route sends strictly less than the Agent SDK route

portMapping.note: [Observed in the adapter source at drafting] the ports exist; the usage figure is the sum of the final message's token counts across the tries made, Unknown (null) when any count is not a non-negative integer or any try's billing is unknown, so usage fields are Unknown (Missing quantity) rather than zero when unreported; the model identifier is the final message's model field

unknowns: [Unknown] whether the real API accepts output_config.effort, or the adaptive thinking field, for the pinned model with this body: only a capture endpoint has seen these bytes (PROVIDER-EGRESS-BYTES.md, PR #264)
[Unknown] traffic on paths the capture did not take: error handling beyond 429 and 529, long streams and connection resets
[Unknown] whether the SDK library writes a file outside the run directory
the model's context window and the account's rate limits
the provider's own retention under the terms and settings of the key used, which the egress record discloses and does not promise
[Unknown] no code at the cited commit reads SYZYGY_POLARIS_PROVIDER_API_KEY; the credential path is a proposal until the caller exists
[Unknown] the x-stainless-timeout and connection values: the cited predicate checks their names only

gateOrConfigurationCannotMeetRouteCondit.note: an invalid configuration, a missing key, an SDK version other than the pin, a missing upstream or an unwritable run directory: an environment the profile could not satisfy (RFC2-24 reason 12); not an observer error, and no degradation state is invented

gateRefusedRequest.executionFact: the gate answered 403 and no byte left
gateRefusedRequest.unknownReason: unconsented-source-or-provider when the consent switch refused; execution-blocked when the acceptance predicate or the upstream setting refused
gateRefusedRequest.note: the adapter's egress-refused failure; the gate decision records name fields, never values

usageUncertain.note: the pipeline stops with usage-uncertain when a try's billing is unknown; absent tokens are Unknown, never zero (RFC2-23). RFC2-23 names no reason for Missing quantity: unreported usage is an absent evidence quantity for a cost claim, which is reason 2 rather than an uncaptured deterministic input (reason 10) [Inferred]

failureStates.dispatchUncertain: not a degradation state: an execution fact (the pipeline stops with effect-uncertain and a lease expiry never replays the request), routed through the existing claim-reason predicate like budget exhaustion (ADAPTER-DECLARATIONS.md, failure behaviour)
failureStates.budgetExhaustedOrRejectedOutput: not a degradation state: distinct execution facts (ADAPTER-DECLARATIONS.md, failure behaviour); a reply with no text, or with a block other than text or thinking, is rejected output

adapterFailureAtReachableEndpoint.note: a provider error status, or rate limiting that outlasts the retry budget (429 and 529 are retried inside it), at a reachable endpoint is an adapter error (RFC4-4), distinct from routeUnreachable

failureStates.cancelledOrDeadline: not a degradation state: execution facts like budget exhaustion (the pipeline stops with cancelled or deadline; the adapter's aborted and deadline failures), routed through the existing claim-reason predicate

admissionFailureMapping.missingConsent: unconsented-source-or-provider (a refused effect under the permission predicate; no withdrawal event is invented)

entries.supersession: signing these bytes would register the route's declared boundary and enable nothing; a usable entry is a later observerVersion that fills implementationVersion and governingBehaviorContract.version, is reviewed afresh and is signed by its own act (rule 10: any byte change retires this row)

routeSubstitution.rule: RFC4-1: every external authority is reached through exactly one registered adapter per project. This entry is a SUBSTITUTE for the Agent SDK entry polaris-provider-route-anthropic-agent-sdk (PR #255), never an addition: it names the same project and the same provider authority, and adopting it replaces that entry by a successor version or entry under a new act; it never runs beside it and neither falls back to the other
routeSubstitution.onlyOneAdoptable: an owner who signs both entries leaves two registered adapters for one authority, which RFC4-1 forbids; the packet asks for exactly one

runtimePin.note: [Inferred] per PROVIDER-EGRESS-BYTES.md (PR #264): the header literals were observed against 0.131.0 and are enforced as literals, so another SDK version makes requests fail closed until the literals are re-derived; the adapter is unmerged and a bump is a new entry version. There is no bundled CLI or subprocess

snapshotInputMapping.label: [Inferred] RFC2-1 items; the installed Butlers entry carries no mapping, so the gap is inherited and this mapping is the drafter's
snapshotInputMapping.admitted-source-bundle: item 8 (deterministic configuration affecting classification) and item 1 for the admitted revisions it was drawn from
snapshotInputMapping.api-key-credential: none: never recorded (its presence is a precondition, not a snapshot input)
snapshotInputMapping.outputs: provider-reply-capture, usage-record, dispatch-evidence and model-identity are item 6

requestBytes.status: the exact request the route may carry for the pinned version, inline so the bytes an act binds are these bytes; the cited source is provenance only and its later edits change nothing here

provenance.label: [Observed, capture endpoint with a dummy credential, no provider contacted] by the author of PR #264; this entry only copies the values. The header literals and shapes below are those of acceptMessagesApiRequest in messages-api-provider.ts at this commit. No separate review record of the header list exists at drafting; the reviewer re-derives it from the source and the capture test. The branch is unmerged
provenance.note: each blob is the file at that commit (git rev-parse <commit>:<path>); the builder re-checks the pairs whenever the commit is present in the local object database

requestBytes.bodyFields: exactly: max_tokens, messages, model, output_config, stream, system, and thinking only when the profile is adaptive; no tools, metadata, context_management or cache_control field; system is a string, messages has one user message whose content is a string, output_config is exactly {effort}, stream is true
generatorBuilt: system: exactly the stage system prompt, as a string (no cache_control)
messages[0]: one user message whose content is exactly the stage input envelope, as a string (no cache_control)
sdkFixed: the headers below, in the literals and shapes listed
runtimeFixed: none: no subprocess, no system prefix, no empty system message, no metadata

routeFixedByThisEntry.tools: absent: the body has no tools field
routeFixedByThisEntry.thinking: profile-set, one of two values only: off (the thinking field is absent) or adaptive (exactly {"type":"adaptive"}). Any other value, including an enabled form with budget_tokens, is not a permitted configuration of this entry even though the adapter source accepts it, and the acceptance check refuses it
routeFixedByThisEntry.maxTokensCeiling: [Inferred proposal, an owner choice] 64000, because a multi-page draft stage can exceed 32000; check it against the first requests run; the sent max_tokens is the minimum of this ceiling, the profile's maxOutputTokens and the dispatch permit's output and usage allowances (at least 1), so the permit may only lower it
routeFixedByThisEntry.note: model, tools, effort, thinking and max_tokens are profile-set in the measurement; this entry pins them so they are bytes it lists as fixed, the form the egress record admits

valueRules.x-api-key: equal to the configured credential and non-empty; the credential is never recorded
valueRules.content-length: the byte length of the body, computed
valueRules.host: set by the transport: at the loopback egress gate it matches ^127\.0\.0\.1:\d{1,5}$; the gate removes it, and the forwarded request names the one upstream host the gate is configured with
valueRules.connection: optional; set by the transport and removed by the gate; the cited predicate checks the name only [Unknown: no value is pinned]
valueRules.x-stainless-timeout: optional; the SDK's request timeout in seconds. [Inferred] the entry bounds it to ^\d{1,5}$; the cited predicate checks the name only, so an implementation must enforce this shape before the entry is usable

headers.unlisted: any header name outside closedSet, or a value outside its literal, shape or rule, fails the acceptance check; there is no open class of transport headers; anthropic-beta, authorization and cookie are not in the set
headers.machineFingerprint: x-stainless-os, x-stainless-arch and x-stainless-runtime-version identify the machine and are sent; the cited gate has a stripFingerprint option, default off, which removes them from the forwarded request but not from what the acceptance predicate sees; whether the egress record should require stripping is an owner choice (packet O2) and this entry assumes no answer

requestBytes.probe: none: the route sends no HEAD /api/hello; a probe arriving at the gate would be answered locally and never forwarded
absentByConstruction: tools, metadata, context_management and cache_control fields
a system prefix or an empty system message
the ?beta=true query and the anthropic-beta header
any cookie, authorization or other header not listed
a thinking field other than the two permitted values
requestBytes.unlistedBytes: any byte, header or field not listed above fails the acceptance check; the sent max_tokens, model, effort and thinking are compared by value with the values this entry pins

entries.determinismClassNote: the scalar form is kept for the shape precedent's key and names the primary class; determinismByOutputClass is the machine form and governs
